_meta.project: CSNO-ESP — research on the Android CS:GO-style port CSNO (com.ledi.csno, by 乐迪)
_meta.source: static analysis of libkm_client_panorama_client.so / libkm_engine_client.so (NDK r27, unstripped, aarch64)
_meta.usage: netvars are struct offsets (arch-independent: valid on Houdini-x86 and native arm64). rva_seeds are THIS build only — resolve module bases at runtime and verify seeds, or fall back to signatures.
_meta.warning: Offsets verified statically from RecvTable constructors. Phase 2 must re-verify dynamically before ESP use.

rva_seeds_this_build._comment: Validation seeds for THIS km_ build only — never hardcode; resolve via runtime module base and confirm, or locate by signature.

s_pLocalPlayer.formula: localPlayer = *(base + rva + 8*slot); slot: -1 (GetLocalPlayer(-1)) maps to index 0

s_EntityList.formula: entity = *(entityList + 0x28 + 0x20*index) — DIRECT pointer, no wrapper (empirically confirmed in-match 2026-09-30); entry[0]=local player

fn_ScreenTransform.kind: bool ScreenTransform(Vector const& in, Vector& out) — returns visibility; out in [-1,1] clip space

DT_CSPlayer_RecvTable.kind: RecvTable; props array at 0x1F6B228, 110 props, RecvProp size 0x60

g_EngineRenderer.formula: viewMatrix (VMatrix, 16 floats) = *(CRender + 0xA4) for primary view; per-view stride 0x220

signatures._comment: Wildcarded (??) byte patterns; ADRP/ADD immediates wildcarded so patterns survive rebuilds. Resolve global by decoding ADRP+ADD at the match.

GetLocalPlayer_accessor.extract: ADRP x9 at +8, ADD x9,#imm at +12 -> s_pLocalPlayer = page+imm; then ldr x0,[x9, x8, lsl #3] confirms array stride 8

GetClientEntity.extract: formula only: entry = this + 0x20*index; ptr at +8; entity = vcall(vtbl+0x38)

ScreenTransform_client.anchor_rva_hint: inside fn at 0xBC0768: adrp x8,#..; ldr x8,[x8,#0xef8]; ldr x8,[x8]; ldr x9,[x8,#0x128]
ScreenTransform_client.extract: GOT slot at page+0xEF8 holds ptr to client 'engine' global (0x1639C08); vtbl+0x128 = WorldToScreenMatrix

WorldToScreenMatrix_engine.extract: ADRP x8 at +0, ADD x8,#0x220 at +4 -> g_EngineRenderer = page+0x220

entity_list.formula: entity = *(u64*)(clientBase + 0x16432A0 + 0x28 + 0x20*index) — DIRECT C_BaseEntity*, empirically confirmed in-match 2026-09-30
entity_list.player_indices: 0 = local player, 1..N players (bot match: 10 entries at 0..9); unused slots are null
entity_list.dormancy: m_bDormant is NOT a netvar in this build, and m_nTickBase is useless for remote entities (DT_LocalPlayerExclusive networks it only for the local player — verified in-match: local ticks +65/s, bots STATIC by design). Use m_bSpotted (0xECD, networked) or origin-staleness tracking.
entity_list.player_filter: hp > 0 && m_iTeamNum != 0 — entity indices 0..N are players; indices 64+ in the same list are world entities (weapons/props) with team=0
entity_list.performance_lesson: GB-scale Memory.scanSync passes freeze the game under Houdini (3.1GB scan = 48s, game unresponsive). Production reads: ~130 pointers from the known array — milliseconds.
